methods.label: Substitute 7 and compare the fractions
methods.explanation:
Substituting \(x=7\), the five choices become
\[
\frac67,\quad \frac68,\quad 1,\quad \frac76,\quad \frac86.
\]
The last two are greater than \(1\), while the first two are less than \(1\). Of the fractions \(6/7\) and \(6/8\), the one with the larger denominator is smaller because both have the same positive numerator. Thus the smallest value is \(\boxed{\frac68=\frac34}\), choice B.
